## Checklist

- [ ] `bash scripts/smoke-test.sh` passes against a running app
- [ ] Tenant-scoped queries filter by the current user's id (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Data model changes include a migration and the updated model snapshot
- [ ] UI changes include a rebuilt `wwwroot/css/tailwind.css` and a screenshot below
- [ ] README / CLAUDE.md updated if behaviour or commands changed
